bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
p=/home/admin1/logs/servercore-service-deploy/req_9d48eccd59b170836ea6565e.json
type=UNKNOWN
if [ -r "$p" ]; then
 e=$(jq -r '.stderr // ""' "$p")
 if printf '%s' "$e" | grep -qi 'permission denied'; then type=PERMISSION_DENIED
 elif printf '%s' "$e" | grep -qi 'compose'; then type=COMPOSE_ERROR
 elif printf '%s' "$e" | grep -qi 'not found'; then type=NOT_FOUND
 elif printf '%s' "$e" | grep -qi 'docker'; then type=DOCKER_ERROR
 elif [ -z "$e" ]; then type=NO_STDERR
 else type=OTHER; fi
fi
body=$(printf 'V8_FAILED_BUILD_CLASSIFICATION\nclass=%s\nledger_readable=%s\n' "$type" "$(test -r "$p" && echo yes || echo no)")
gh api -X POST repos/G-ACE-inc/server-core/issues/10/comments -f body="$body" --jq '.html_url'
